scenes.title: Companion Hub
scenes.caption: Your data. Your hardware. Your AI.
scenes.narration: Companion Hub is the app runtime that lives in your house.

scenes.caption: A local admin account. Nothing off this machine required.
scenes.narration: It opens on a local login. Signing in anywhere else is optional.

shots.alt: The Hub login form: a CI Account button above the local email and password fields.

scenes.caption: Six characters, and the machine is yours.
scenes.narration: A new Hub asks for one pairing code from Companion Portal.

shots.alt: Step 2: Connect this device, with the pairing-code field waiting for six characters.

scenes.caption: Local models, network, apps. Then Install & Finish.
scenes.narration: First boot is one pass. Local models, network, apps.

shots.alt: The Set Up Your Hub wizard with its sticky Install and Finish footer.

scenes.caption: Disk, CPU, memory. From a box you can point at.
scenes.narration: This is home. Disk, CPU and memory, read off hardware you own.

shots.alt: The Hub dashboard: three system stat cards above the installed-apps row.

scenes.caption: The App Store, fed by the open Hub market.
scenes.narration: The store is fed by the open Hub market. Search, or browse.

shots.alt: The Hub App Store on its featured view, with the category sidebar and the search field.

scenes.caption: Alternatives: the app you rent, and the one you own.
scenes.narration: For the software you rent, the store names the open replacement you can own.

shots.alt: The store's Alternatives view: a table pairing proprietary products with the open source apps that replace them.

scenes.caption: App Privacy, on every single app page.
scenes.narration: Every app page carries an App Privacy card. It is a short read.

shots.alt: Immich's app page in the Hub store, scrolled to the App Privacy card beside the Information panel.

scenes.caption: Ports, domains and settings, shown before anything runs.
scenes.narration: Secrets generate themselves. Everything else an app asks for, you see before it runs.

shots.alt: The Install Immich dialog open over the app page, listing the ports, domain and settings the app is asking for.
